name: blur-fade
title: Blur Fade
description: Fades content in out of a blur, from any direction, on mount or when it scrolls into view.

props.name: delay
props.description: Seconds to wait before the fade starts.

props.name: offset
props.description: Pixels the content travels while it fades in.

props.name: direction
props.description: Direction the content moves while it appears.

props.name: blur
props.description: Blur radius in pixels at the start.

props.name: inView
props.description: Wait until the content scrolls into view.

props.name: inViewMargin
props.description: Margin around the viewport used by inView.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the content right away, with no animation.
